message.content: {"claims":[{"quote":"Most shoppers abandon checkout at the card entry form."},{"quote":"Support tickets about failed card entry\ndoubled between March and June."}],"needs":[{"quote":"Shoppers need to pay without retyping their card number on every purchase."}],"stories":[{"quote":"As a returning shopper, I want to save my card so that I can check out in one tap."}],"dependencies":[{"quote":"Card data must be stored and processed in line with PCI DSS version 4.0."},{"quote":"Settlement files must be\ndelivered to Acme Bank by 06:00 UTC under the signed Master Services Agreement."},{"quote":"Delivery depends on the Fraud team shipping the new risk-scoring API."}]}
